architecture.render_path: Raster Shape Registry -> shared ShapeSpecRenderer -> LockTokenPainter
architecture.style_behavior: Raster illustrated Shape bypasses vector Soft Basic/Crayon geometry while remaining compatible with shared token rendering.
architecture.palette_behavior: ShapeTone is applied with BlendMode.color, then original raster alpha is re-applied with dstIn so palette output is clipped to turtle pixels only while luminance/material detail survives.
architecture.bootstrap: RasterShapeBootstrap loads raster assets after runApp for both MyLockApp and MyLockLockApp; loading/error UI prevents blank-screen failure.
architecture.runtime_note: Runtime v2 adds safety padding to address crop-edge artifacts, but 58 px remains an intermediate runtime texture source and is not the long-term production architecture.

validation.android_apk_build: previous integration CI PASS; current v2 follow-up not promoted to Final

next_gate: Runtime v3: 256 padded Runtime Master + metadata-driven placement + 2-layer Palette Base/Fixed Finish renderer + Aurora Sea animated palette + production-component QA.
known_issues: 58 px texture used as a runtime source is too small for rotation, enlargement, and animation quality.
Shape-specific visualScale compensation is a magic-number pattern and should be replaced by metadata-driven framing.
Single-layer BlendMode.color affects all opaque raster pixels; long-term renderer should separate Palette Base from Fixed Finish.
Runtime v2 safety padding is an interim fix for rectangular crop-edge artifacts, not the final architecture.
